macros.name: defcellcode
macros.doc: The command \defcellcode allows to execute any code in a unique cell, or in every cells of a row or in every cells of a column.

macros.name: htablecalc
macros.doc: The macro \htablecalc builds horizontal table whose first row contains the "values" and the other rows the "results".

macros.name: htablecalc
macros.doc: The macro \htablecalc builds horizontal table whose first row contains the "values" and the other rows the "results".

macros.name: tcatbeginrow
macros.doc: At the begining of a row, when it is displayed, the macro \tcatbeginrow runs.

macros.name: tcprintresult
macros.doc: To display a result, the macro \tcprintresult is called. It requires two arguments: the first is the number to display in raw format coming from pgfcalc and the second is the value used to compute the result.

macros.name: tcprintroundresult
macros.doc: To avoid writing many times round(number,precision) in the code, tabularcalc provides \tcprintroundresult. Its mandatory argument is the precision of the decimal part.

macros.name: tcprintroundresult*
macros.doc: To avoid writing many times round(number,precision) in the code, tabularcalc provides \tcprintroundresult. Its mandatory argument is the precision of the decimal part.

macros.name: tcprintvalue
macros.doc: To display a value, the macro \tcprintvalue is called. It requires one argument: the number to display which comes from pgfcalc.

macros.name: tcresethrule
macros.doc: The command \tcresethrule resets the defined lines and restores the default lines.

macros.name: tcsetcoltype
macros.doc: The command \tcsetcoltype has an optionnal argument and 2 mandatory arguments: • the optional argument, empty by default, defines the vertical lines at the right of the table; • the "type 1" of the first column, set to "|c|" by default; • the "type 2" of the other colunms, set to "c|" by default.

macros.name: tcsetcoltype
macros.doc: The command \tcsetcoltype has an optionnal argument and 2 mandatory arguments: • the optional argument, empty by default, defines the vertical lines at the right of the table; • the "type 1" of the first column, set to "|c|" by default; • the "type 2" of the other colunms, set to "c|" by default.

macros.name: tcwritetofile
macros.doc: The \tcwritetofile{⟨filename⟩} has a mandatory argument which is the name of a file without extension. The next \htablecalc or \vtablecalc after this command will not display the tables, but a file named ⟨filename⟩.tex will be written in the current directory, and its content will be the code of the table.

macros.name: vtablecalc
macros.doc: The macro \vtablecalc builds vertical table whose first column contains the "values" and the other rows the "results".

macros.name: vtablecalc
macros.doc: The macro \vtablecalc builds vertical table whose first column contains the "values" and the other rows the "results".
